hypotheses.title: PowerShell Fileless Malware on Endpoints
hypotheses.confirmation_criteria: powershell.exe with -enc flag, base64 payload, spawned from Office or browser
hypotheses.refutation_criteria: All encoded PS traces to documented IT automation with approved hashes
hypotheses.false_positive_notes: IT team uses encoded PS for deployment — cross-reference against approved accounts

hypotheses.title: Lateral Movement via SMB
hypotheses.confirmation_criteria: Event ID 4624 Type 3 logons between workstations outside business hours
hypotheses.refutation_criteria: All W2W authentications correlate with documented IT activities
hypotheses.false_positive_notes: Backup agents create legitimate W2W auth — allowlist known service accounts

hypotheses.title: Kerberoasting Service Account Theft
hypotheses.confirmation_criteria: Multiple Event ID 4769 with etype 0x17 from single non-service account in short window
hypotheses.refutation_criteria: All RC4 ticket requests from documented legacy apps requiring RC4 compatibility
hypotheses.false_positive_notes: Legacy applications may request RC4 — document all known legacy systems

hypotheses.title: DNS-Based C2 Tunneling
hypotheses.confirmation_criteria: Apex domains with >20 unique high-entropy subdomains, NXDOMAIN ratio >60%
hypotheses.refutation_criteria: All high-entropy DNS queries trace to CDN or update services on allowlist
hypotheses.false_positive_notes: CDN providers use long subdomains — maintain apex domain allowlist
